_readme: This file is the list of series the scraper tracks. It is plain JSON —
edit it in any text editor, no programming required. See docs/CATALOGUE.md.
source  — where to fetch from: gutenberg | mangadex | flamecomics | fixture
id      — the work id / manga UUID / fixture file name  (flamecomics uses slug)
type    — manga | manhwa | lightnovel | webnovel   (we never guess this)
enabled — true to include it in the next run, false to park it
Everything else is optional and overrides what the source reports.
A trailing comma anywhere will break the file: JSON does not allow them.

series._note: Hand-written placeholder prose. Never touches the network, so the app always has something to read.
Original sample serial, 24 chapters of ~1,100 words. The long-serial case: infinite scroll and 'continue reading'.
Original sample web novel, 40 chapters of ~300 words. The short-chapter case: fast chapter-to-chapter navigation.
Original sample novel, 6 chapters of ~3,500 words. The long-chapter case: paged mode and anchor preservation.
Original sample image series, 8 chapters x 10 committed SVG pages. The image-reader case, with no network and no hosting.

series.description: Mary Shelley's 1818 novel, told in letters and then in Victor Frankenstein's own voice. Medium-length chapters; the epistolary opening exercises headings that are not the word "Chapter".
Sixty-one short-to-medium chapters — the long multi-part novel in this sample, and the one to scroll through when testing infinite mode.
Moby-Dick has 135 chapters and many of them are a page or two long, which makes it the short-chapter stress test for chapter navigation.
Twelve Sherlock Holmes stories. Each "chapter" is a whole short story of eight to twelve thousand words — the very-long-chapter case for paged mode and progress tracking.
Twelve short chapters, verse interludes and scene breaks — small enough to download over a bad connection while testing.
War and Peace is organised as books within volumes, so its chapter titles carry a book prefix. Included to exercise deep chapter lists.
